map.税额 = 利息 × 税率 使用指南: Tax = Interest x Tax Rate User Guide
map.利息所得税计算器：输入利息所得与适用税率，计算代扣利息所得税额，用于个人理财与税: Interest income tax calculator: enter interest income and the applicable tax rate to compute the withheld interest income tax; used for personal finance and tax accounting.
map.由利息所得与适用税率计算代扣税。: Compute the withheld tax from interest income and the applicable tax rate.
map.对利息收入 × 税率计征，算税后利息。: Levied on interest income x tax rate, giving after-tax interest.
map.对比存款、债券利息的含税收益。: Compare the after-tax returns on deposits and bond interest.
map.评估免税利息收入（如国债）的差异。: Evaluate the difference for tax-exempt interest income (such as government bonds).
map.：利息所得税 = 5000 × 0.20 = 1,000 元；税后利息 = 50: : Interest income tax = 5000 x 0.20 = 1,000 CNY; after-tax interest = 5000 - 1000 = 4,000 CNY.
map.：若利息来自免税品种（税率 0），则所得税 0、税后利息全额 5000 元。: : If the interest comes from a tax-exempt instrument (tax rate 0), the income tax is 0 and the after-tax interest is the full 5000 CNY.
map.由相邻级距税额差与收入差求边际税率: Marginal tax rate from the difference in bracket tax and the difference in income
map.由工资金额与双方费率求工薪税合计: Total payroll tax from the wage amount and both parties' rates
map.分档累加：各档 (应税−下限) × 档率: Bracket-by-bracket accumulation: for each bracket (taxable amount - lower bound) x bracket rate
map.税额 = 计税余值 × 税率: Tax = taxable remainder x tax rate
map.哪些利息可能免税？: Which interest may be tax exempt?
map.国债、地方债等特定品种利息常免征所得税，具体以现行税法为准。: Interest on certain instruments such as government bonds and local government bonds is often exempt from income tax; the current tax law governs in detail.
map.税率用小数还是百分数？: Enter the tax rate as a decimal or as a percentage?
map.r 输入百分数（如 20 代表 20%），内部按 0.20 计算。: Enter r as a percentage (for example 20 means 20%); internally it is computed as 0.20.
